- **Scope:** av-cam CC 3D LUT and gamma, the Arrivederci/ARRI color work, debayer/PSF/detail stages, RAW develop, IMX284, Open Gate and high-bit-depth paths, AIF DMA and the RCRAW probes.

### <a id="f02"></a>F02 - Which latch arms S-Ele when the open-gate height grows

- **State:** `done`
- **Next:** Closed by E0698: the latch source is Lost CAMOUT_V at 0x63907E6A, with rcv_ovf 0x044B02CA and sdvga_ovf 0x044B02C9 both zero in the E0696 trace. The SGC H/V words do track the patched period, so they were not the ceiling.
- **Evidence:** [E0696](../evidence/0696-a6400-squeezed-open-gate-live-ram-preflight-and-test4.md), [E0697](../evidence/0697-a6400-open-gate-upper-ceiling-static-analysis.md), [E0698](../evidence/0698-a6400-open-gate-camout-v-plus24-root-cause.md)

### <a id="f03"></a>F03 - Which stock-valued vertical limit rejects every dy greater than 0

- **State:** `done`
- **Next:** Closed by E0702 + E0703: all in-image av-cam.bin carriers (R1 rcv_desc, R2/R4 band clamp, R3 SGC, R6 0xF3122000, 0xF3851xxx/0xF3951xxx, and [[parent+0x8C]]+0x3D8 = fe_rec+0x4E0..+0x528) are ruled out. The upward dy > 0 Lost CAMOUT_V ceiling is enforced on the external CAM front-end side across the ORIL boundary (R5), outside shipped ARM software.
- **Evidence:** [E0698](../evidence/0698-a6400-open-gate-camout-v-plus24-root-cause.md), [E0699](../evidence/0699-a6400-open-gate-plus8-and-rcv-isolation-live.md), [E0700](../evidence/0700-a6400-open-gate-fe-input-cap-and-002-mmio-trace.md), [E0701](../evidence/0701-a6400-open-gate-r4-refutation-live.md), [E0702](../evidence/0702-a6400-open-gate-r5-r6-and-still-vs-4k-diff.md), [E0703](../evidence/0703-a6400-open-gate-f3851-mmio-live.md)

## Hazards (read before any camera run)

| ID | Hazard | Effect | Rule | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="h01"></a>H01 | Color matrix RAM patches persist | The a6400 color matrix table at 0x6444a044 is saved to /setting/Backup.* on power-off, so RAM patches become persistent. | Restore original matrix values before power-off unless a persistent change is intended and authorized. | [E0555](../evidence/0555-arrivederci-menu-exit-recompute-and-cc8-refill.md) |
| <a id="h02"></a>H02 | S-Ele refresh fault store reboots the camera | When refresh_counter is above 10 and bit 0x40 of PA 0x0434FD7E is clear, 0x63907870 stores through r7==0 and the camera reboots. | A live open-gate height test that can arm the S-Ele latch needs the existing noreboot bit set first, and must clear it again before the session ends. | [E0696](../evidence/0696-a6400-squeezed-open-gate-live-ram-preflight-and-test4.md), [E0697](../evidence/0697-a6400-open-gate-upper-ceiling-static-analysis.md) |
| <a id="h03"></a>H03 | Any upward open-gate FE/RCV step loses CAMOUT_V | plus24 (+24) and test4 (+160, with lockstep timing) both lost CAMOUT_V and raised refresh_cnt, while shrink (-160), test1 (sensor only) and timing4 (timing only) stayed clean. The ceiling is the stock FE/RCV geometry itself, not the 3480 line budget: test4 kept the stock 35-line margin and still failed. | Treat dy greater than 0 as unverified until F03 names the stock-valued limit. Do not spend a live run on +160-class steps; bisect from +8 with noreboot set. | [E0698](../evidence/0698-a6400-open-gate-camout-v-plus24-root-cause.md) |

### <a id="img-cc-lut"></a>av-cam CC 3D LUT, color matrix and EC gamma

`img.cc-lut` | process

av-cam's CC: 3D LUT (5x9x9 YCbCr), 3x3 Q10 color matrix and EC_Gamma (96 x uint16) applied before 8-bit output.

Aliases: `CC:`, `EC_Gamma`, `5x9x9 YCbCr`, `CC+8`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` av-cam.bin applies a CC: 3D LUT (5x9x9 YCbCr), a 3x3 Q10 color matrix and EC_Gamma (96 x uint16) before the 8-bit stage. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` Arrivederci applies without a Color Mode round trip because CC+8 is refilled every frame; it uses a matrix fitted to the official ARRI Classic LUT, and an A/B recording test (C0029 on vs C0030 off) verified it live. ([E0555](../evidence/0555-arrivederci-menu-exit-recompute-and-cc8-refill.md), [E0556](../evidence/0556-arrivederci-classic-fitted-matrix.md), [E0610](../evidence/0610-live-a6400-arrivederci-v4-zebra-ab-test.md))

`img.recording-paths` | process

Current knowledge:

- **C06** `OFFLINE` Open Gate 3:2 recording, 4K/6K low-fps paths and 10-bit / 11-14-bit RAW/YCC video paths were mapped statically and in Unicorn; sabin ZIMA_AVC encoders cap at 8-bit 4:2:0. ([E0578](../evidence/0578-a6400-open-gate-3-2-recording-feasibility.md), [E0620](../evidence/0620-a6400-open-gate-4k-and-6k-paths.md), [E0621](../evidence/0621-a6400-10bit-and-raw-video-paths.md), [E0627](../evidence/0627-a6400-zima-avc-8bit-ceiling.md))
- **C07** `OFFLINE` The AIF DMA channel table and the SET_RAW_EXTERNAL_OUTPUT gate were mapped; AIF0/1 W1/W2 semantics and the RCRAW DDR path decoded; RCRAW line/block calculation verified in Unicorn. ([E0622](../evidence/0622-a6400-aif-dma-channel-map-and-raw-external-gate.md), [E0623](../evidence/0623-a6400-aif-w1-w2-rcraw-registers.md), [E0624](../evidence/0624-a6400-rcraw-calc-unicorn.md))
- **C12** `OFFLINE` The A7 III squeezed 3:2 Open Gate technique (`reglist` col 11 Y_START/Y_SIZE, 65 vertical fields in `fe_rec_0a`/`fe_rec_19`, and lockstep `h*v` timing tables across `timing_ntsc`/`timing_pal` and runtime `.bss` `rt_t14`) maps to live ILCE-6400 `av-cam.bin` (`dd8f8d0c...`) and passes Unicorn verification for `test1`, `test4` (+156), `test3` (+312), `test2` (+624), and exact `putback`; physical camera testing awaits explicit GO. ([E0695](../evidence/0695-a6400-squeezed-open-gate-a7iii-port-mapping-and-unicorn-verification.md))
- **C13** `PHYSICAL` On physical ILCE-6400 (`dd8f8d0c...`), live RAM tests proved: `Y_START % 4 == 0` flips Bayer parity to magenta (`dy=156`), `test1` (+624 sensor only) and `timing4` (+160 timing only) run smoothly, `shrink` (dy=-160 across all 158 fields) runs at full FPS with `S-Ele refresh_cnt=0`, while `plus24` (dy=+24, `rcv_vtot=3471 < 3480`) triggers low FPS (`refresh_cnt=27`). The camera was restored to `STOCK`. The DMM-allocation cause suggested from that matrix is refuted by E0697. ([E0696](../evidence/0696-a6400-squeezed-open-gate-live-ram-preflight-and-test4.md), [E0697](../evidence/0697-a6400-open-gate-upper-ceiling-static-analysis.md))
- **C14** `OFFLINE` DmmConfig.bin has no 6000/3376/3392/3442 slot size. Rule-5 slot 0x2EF9200 (49,254,912 bytes) still holds 6000x4000x2. The av-cam canvas at 0x63DF199C is 3840x2160-class. DMM is not the dy=+24 ceiling. 0x63DDF414 is not the canvas table in av-cam.bin dd8f8d0c. ([E0697](../evidence/0697-a6400-open-gate-upper-ceiling-static-analysis.md))
- **C15** `OFFLINE` FE selectors 0x63771D78 and 0x63771DE4 are labels in 0x63771C78 and return fe_rec_0a 0x63E14E94 and fe_rec_19 0x63E15E54 for drive keys 0x1F and 0x89. No instruction compares those records to 3392, 3442, 3447, or 3480. The 4K copier at 0x63764578 reads FE+0x28 (3096, unpatched) and FE+0x2A (3392+dy). ([E0697](../evidence/0697-a6400-open-gate-upper-ceiling-static-analysis.md))
- **C16** `OFFLINE` Mode 16 and 17 both select reglist column 11. That column is stored unmodified into IMX284 0x000A/0x000B (Y_START) and 0x000C/0x000D (Y_SIZE). The only column-11 value 3396 is Y_SIZE itself. 0x001D-0x0020 are zero in every column and are a shutter word, not a 3396-line clamp. The former labels 0x0025/0x001E/0x0027/0x001B are the next staging record's address. ([E0697](../evidence/0697-a6400-open-gate-upper-ceiling-static-analysis.md))
- **C18** `OFFLINE` SGC1/SGC2 do not compare the frame against 3392, 3442, 3447, or 3480. hvcycle at 0xF3120220 is packed from BSS 0x64339DF8+0x38/+0x3C, which is outside the 158-entry open-gate patch. rt_t10+0x12 and rt_t18 track h1 when the boot populators run, but plus24 left timing stock and timing4 passed without rewriting them, so those fields are not the plus24 ceiling. ([E0697](../evidence/0697-a6400-open-gate-upper-ceiling-static-analysis.md))
- **C21** `PHYSICAL` The open-gate vertical ceiling is direction-only, not a line budget. Re-derived FE maximum vertical halfword (+0x190) and rcv_b_vtot per case: stock 3445/3447 margin 35 PASS, shrink 3285/3287 margin 195 PASS, test1 3445/3447 margin 35 PASS, timing4 3445/3447 margin 195 PASS, plus24 3469/3471 margin 11 FAIL, test4 3605/3607 margin 35 FAIL. test4 leaves the same 35-line margin as stock against 2x1820=3640 and still loses CAMOUT_V, so the 3480 budget theory is refuted. Every upward move of the FE/RCV set fails, the equal downward move passes, and sensor-only or timing-only moves pass. FE_max minus sensor Y_SIZE is 49 in every case where both move together. ([E0696](../evidence/0696-a6400-squeezed-open-gate-live-ram-preflight-and-test4.md), [E0698](../evidence/0698-a6400-open-gate-camout-v-plus24-root-cause.md))
- **C22** `OFFLINE` IMX284 is exonerated for plus24. In the 125-row reglist, column 11 differs from column 10 in exactly rows 10-13 (0x000A-0x000D); no register encodes a line count, VMAX, crop height, MIPI Y_OUT_SIZE, EBD position, or SLVS packet count; the applicator 0x6379D618 is a bare strb. Stock column 11 already ends at row 3738, above 3480, and test1 puts Y_SIZE 4020 through the same four bytes and passes. 3480 is 2x1740, the host vertical period of timing_rom_ntsc[16]/[17] at 0x63E2598C/0x63E259A4, not a sensor clamp. ([E0698](../evidence/0698-a6400-open-gate-camout-v-plus24-root-cause.md))
- **C23** `OFFLINE` The FE records are lists of 20-byte crop rectangles, and the first halfword of every pair is horizontal, not a height: fe_rec_0a +0x14 3016 pairs with rcv 0x63E19752 6032, +0x264 3012 pairs with 0x63E197AE 6024, and 0x63E1979C is 6000. 0x63CCBFD0 adds its 2928 delta to horizontal outputs only. Therefore +0x028 3096, +0x252/+0x256 1506 and +0x264 3012 are not unpatched heights, and +0x2C8/+0x2CE are dy-independent scalars. The selector is 0x63771C78 over a 16-record table at 0x63E12F14, stride 0x540; key 0x1F/0x89 with variant 0x0A/0x19 returns 0x63E14E94/0x63E15E54. ([E0698](../evidence/0698-a6400-open-gate-camout-v-plus24-root-cause.md))
- **C24** `OFFLINE` The 66-offset FE set covers every vertical halfword in both records; every unpatched non-zero halfword is horizontal, a delta, a mask, or a sentinel. The FE consumer module 0x63CC0000-0x63CE8000 resolves no literal at or above 0xE0000000, and the only device base on that chain is 0xF3120000. No 0xF300xxxx or 0xF301xxxx write with record-derived data exists in a literal-resolved path; a computed 0xF3xxxxxx plus field address inside 0x63CD3xxx is not excluded. ([E0698](../evidence/0698-a6400-open-gate-camout-v-plus24-root-cause.md))
- **C31** `PHYSICAL` plus8 (dy = +8, minimal Bayer-aligned upward step, FE 3400, rcv_b_vtot 3455, timing stock) triggers S-Ele Refresh with noreboot (refresh_cnt = 39, side_cnt = 2, sticky = 0x01, rcv_ovf = 0, sdvga_ovf = 0, uptime monotonic). There is no numeric wall above stock; the upward ceiling is the stock geometry itself. ([E0699](../evidence/0699-a6400-open-gate-plus8-and-rcv-isolation-live.md))
- **C38** `OFFLINE` The IMX284 programming path is transparent but Y_SIZE is not the frame length. 0x6379D618 is the only reglist applicator and is called from one site only, 0x6379F3FA inside C_ImagerCtrl_IMX284::SetMode (0x6379F380, vtable slot 0x028, typeinfo at 0x63F10AE4), never per frame; all dynamic sensor writes go through 0x6379F27C to 0x63CF0320 strb with no mask; the 124-entry list 0x6454CF54 re-sends the live staging cells, and the second reglist 0x64200EB4 is BSS-zero with a never-materialised slot. However column 0 (6000x4000 still) writes Y_SIZE=1132, stock column 11's window bottom 342+3396=3738 exceeds every FE/RCV total, and no register in the 125-row programme or the send lists encodes a line total, VMAX, Y_OUT_SIZE, EBD position or SLVS count. test1 therefore shows a window change is harmless, not that the sensor emitted more lines. ([E0700](../evidence/0700-a6400-open-gate-fe-input-cap-and-002-mmio-trace.md))
- **C39** `OFFLINE` The CAMIN/SLVS receiver has no static line cap. In 0x63798C00-0x6379B000 (GCS2RXLINK, CSI-2 Rx, SubLVDS, ComboPHY) there is no movw/movt immediate in 3000..3700; the link blocks 0xF3E00000 and 0xFC0F0000 are written only with lane/PLL constants and lane-struct bytes; and the only frame check, 0x63799ACC, accumulates +0x7C/+0xB0/+0xB8 and compares against a runtime expected value from *(global+0xC0), which would raise rcv_ovf that stayed 0 in every failing run. The one unconstrained candidate is the SGC-adjacent window 0xF3122000/0xF3123000 +0x144/+0x148/+0x160 written by 0x63799C8C, reached only through 0x63799D04 which has no static caller. ([E0700](../evidence/0700-a6400-open-gate-fe-input-cap-and-002-mmio-trace.md))
- **C46** `OFFLINE` No reglist column carries a ~4000-line readout. In the 13-column dump the largest Y_SIZE is 3396 (column 11); columns 9/10/11 differ from each other in exactly rows 10-13, so 708/2780/3396 are one knob. The five modes whose size_rows V is 4000 (drive keys 0x0B, 0x37, 0x68, 0x4E, 0x2F) select columns 0/1/2, which carry the untouched boot default 106/1132, identical to the staging initial bytes 0x645A1F24=0x04 and 0x645A1DAC=0x6C. The still class is a 53-register switch (0x0000 0x0C->0x04, 0x0001 0x41->0x04, the 0x002C-0x0033 and 0x0038-0x0043 groups, 0x006F, 0x08F1, 0x0924, 0x0ABA and others), so the still line count is sensor-internal and a row-10-13 patch cannot express it. The 65 unreferenced staging cells are mode-invariant and the 344-hit sweep of 0x6379B000-0x637A3000 finds only two readers of 0x63F109E1 and no VMAX/EBD/Y_OUT_SIZE/OP register. ([E0702](../evidence/0702-a6400-open-gate-r5-r6-and-still-vs-4k-diff.md))
- **C48** `OFFLINE` The ILCE-6400 4K vertical contract is a family constant, not a per-body quirk. Reference 6400, ILCE-6400A 1.01 (hash 3029a174) and ZV-E10 2.03 (bc6cba98) are byte-identical on fe_rec_0a, on the 16-record idx 5/8/12 and idx 6/9 values, on the reglist col10-vs-col11 row set [10,11,12,13], on timing rows [16]/[17] (862,1740,1,29,27) and (827,1740,1,29,17), on the 0x6454AC44 band offset table, and on the Lost CAMOUT_V and S-Ele Refresh ng strings; all 19 timing rows have h1 == h2 on all three. Every occurrence of the packed band words 0x03370D75, 0x03270D71, 0x00090032, 0x03200D71, 0x02F20D73 lies inside the FE record table, so no second stock copy exists. ILCE-7M3 is also a CXD90045 body (E0477), and no 7M3 image is present locally. ([E0702](../evidence/0702-a6400-open-gate-r5-r6-and-still-vs-4k-diff.md))
- **C51** `OFFLINE` R6 is refuted and 0x63799D04 does have a static entry. The function starts at 0x63799D04 with ldr r2,[r1] before its push, so prologue inventories miss it. Its only static transfer is a b.w tail call at 0x63CF0628 inside the 4-byte thunk 0x63CF0626, reached from InterfaceCtrl::SetTransfer 0x6379FD48 (dead: caller passes sel=0xFF) and SetImgIfRequest 0x6379FDF0 (vtable slot 0x6451955C). The chain is SetImgIfRequest -> thunk -> MIF_SetMIFDrive 0x63799D04 -> MIF_SetVirtualChannel 0x63799C64 -> MIF_SetMIFMode 0x63799C8C. Values come from the constant ROM table 0x63E25D24 (38 records, stride 0x14, second half at 0x63E25EA0); mode 16 is index 16 = record 0x63E25E64. All five consumed fields (+0x0C, +0x0D, +0x0E, +0x10, +0x12) are zero in every one of the 38 records, so the stock writes to 0xF3122000/0x3000 +0x138/+0x144/+0x148/+0x160 are 0 on both channels. 0x63799C8C has no compare and no abort path, and the block has no in-image reader. ([E0702](../evidence/0702-a6400-open-gate-r5-r6-and-still-vs-4k-diff.md))
- **C55** `OFFLINE` Nothing in the shipped ARM software publishes or invokes CAMOUT. No branch reaches 0x639325C4 or 0x639303D0, no u32 literal equals either entry, and no table slot holds them; the only data pointer to 0x639325C5 is a PIC-computed address at 0x639330C4/0x63933506 passed to formatter 0x63D0F560. liro.ko validates the ORIL header and blx-calls entry(pre)=0x635C6044 without touching the data table, and im.elf is the launcher of /system/av-cam.bin. No .ko (liro, upm, mcmn_drv, mag, dmm, stream, stream2, osal_uipc, osal_utm, utimer) and no blob (dfe_app, dfe_dat, idt_cam, sa_dfdet, ssboot, bootin.elf, bonobo.bin, lif_app.bin, ldr_drv.bin) contains CAMOUT, CAMIN, vfc, frc, S-Ele or any CAMOUT address, and no module holds a stock height as a data word. The commit body also writes BSS cell 0x64369138, distinct from p[0]/p[1]. ([E0702](../evidence/0702-a6400-open-gate-r5-r6-and-still-vs-4k-diff.md))

### <a id="img-sgc-trim"></a>SgcDev::UpdateWindow trim and phase servo 0x6376910C

`img.sgc-trim` | function

Trim/phase applier with a 32:8 servo (0x63CCFA54 = r0 & -r1 after >>2). Consumes its one-shot trim at exit, writes only phase and period words, and has no start, enable or abort register. Its two static callers are mode/timing apply wrappers.

Aliases: `0x6376910C`, `UpdateWindow`, `0xF312032C`, `0xF3120438`

Current knowledge:

- **C40** `PHYSICAL` SGC1/SGC2/SGC3 are exonerated for the FE stall. The live sgc1_win bytes are a verbatim copy of one timing_rom_ntsc record: 0x63E2598C = H 862, V 1740, c/d/e = 1/29/27 for mode 16 and 0x63E259A4 = H 827, V 1740, 1/29/17 for mode 17, with the MSC record 0x63E2592C = 858/1750/0/0/0; the triple 01 1D 1B occurs exactly four times in the image, all in that table. 0x6376910C is a trim and phase servo that writes no start, enable or abort register, consumes its one-shot trim at exit, and has two static callers inside mode/timing apply wrappers. 0x63CE6630..0x63CE677C is a read-only snapshot of the separate 0xF3021100/0xF3021200 unit with no restore writer. Every live run holds the same mode 16/17 and therefore byte-identical SGC state, while plus24_fe[0..1) fails and plus24_rcvonly passes. ([E0699](../evidence/0699-a6400-open-gate-plus8-and-rcv-isolation-live.md), [E0700](../evidence/0700-a6400-open-gate-fe-input-cap-and-002-mmio-trace.md))
- **C42** `INFERENCE` Three candidates survive for the stock-valued FE vertical reference, none separable offline. R4: the FE band clamp, because 0x6376910C compares lo(+0x438)/lo(+0x43C) against lo(+0x428) and lo(+0x42C), which are programmed from rec+0x194 (0, not in the 66-offset set) and rec+0x198 (3441, in the set), so the pair scales asymmetrically and any over-limit request rewrites the band. R5: a stock-valued copy of the FE vertical geometry on the publish side of the CAMOUT boundary. R6: the SGC-adjacent receiver window 0xF3122000/0xF3123000 +0x144/+0x160 written from a struct whose base is not statically closed. ([E0700](../evidence/0700-a6400-open-gate-fe-input-cap-and-002-mmio-trace.md))

### <a id="img-imx284-window"></a>IMX284 Y window registers 0x000A-0x000D

`img.imx284-window` | device

Mode 16/17 copy reglist column 11 into sensor registers 0x000A/0x000B (Y_START) and 0x000C/0x000D (Y_SIZE). Rows 0x001D-0x0020 are a shutter word, not a 3396-line clamp.

Aliases: `Y_START`, `Y_SIZE`, `0x000A`, `0x000C`, `IMX284`

Current knowledge:

- **C16** `OFFLINE` Mode 16 and 17 both select reglist column 11. That column is stored unmodified into IMX284 0x000A/0x000B (Y_START) and 0x000C/0x000D (Y_SIZE). The only column-11 value 3396 is Y_SIZE itself. 0x001D-0x0020 are zero in every column and are a shutter word, not a 3396-line clamp. The former labels 0x0025/0x001E/0x0027/0x001B are the next staging record's address. ([E0697](../evidence/0697-a6400-open-gate-upper-ceiling-static-analysis.md))
- **C22** `OFFLINE` IMX284 is exonerated for plus24. In the 125-row reglist, column 11 differs from column 10 in exactly rows 10-13 (0x000A-0x000D); no register encodes a line count, VMAX, crop height, MIPI Y_OUT_SIZE, EBD position, or SLVS packet count; the applicator 0x6379D618 is a bare strb. Stock column 11 already ends at row 3738, above 3480, and test1 puts Y_SIZE 4020 through the same four bytes and passes. 3480 is 2x1740, the host vertical period of timing_rom_ntsc[16]/[17] at 0x63E2598C/0x63E259A4, not a sensor clamp. ([E0698](../evidence/0698-a6400-open-gate-camout-v-plus24-root-cause.md))
- **C34** `PHYSICAL` Binary search across the 66 FE offsets under plus24 (sensor +24, size_rows/rt_t14/rcv_desc/timing stock, noreboot on) showed every failing prefix down to [0..1): [0..33) ref=20, [0..16) severe stutter requiring battery pull, [0..8) ref=53, [0..4) ref=32, [0..2) ref=19, and [0..1) (only fe_rec +0x002 3442->3466) FAIL with refresh_cnt = 17. Crucially, the exact complement [1..66) (+0x002 kept stock 3442, all other 65 FE fields +24) ALSO failed with refresh_cnt = 22 (rcv_ovf = 0, sdvga_ovf = 0). Therefore neither +0x002 alone nor inter-field FE inconsistency is the sole fault: any FE stage raised above stock stalls CAMOUT_V, implying the upstream sensor/CAMIN stream into FE is still capped at stock vertical lines. ([E0699](../evidence/0699-a6400-open-gate-plus8-and-rcv-isolation-live.md))
- **C38** `OFFLINE` The IMX284 programming path is transparent but Y_SIZE is not the frame length. 0x6379D618 is the only reglist applicator and is called from one site only, 0x6379F3FA inside C_ImagerCtrl_IMX284::SetMode (0x6379F380, vtable slot 0x028, typeinfo at 0x63F10AE4), never per frame; all dynamic sensor writes go through 0x6379F27C to 0x63CF0320 strb with no mask; the 124-entry list 0x6454CF54 re-sends the live staging cells, and the second reglist 0x64200EB4 is BSS-zero with a never-materialised slot. However column 0 (6000x4000 still) writes Y_SIZE=1132, stock column 11's window bottom 342+3396=3738 exceeds every FE/RCV total, and no register in the 125-row programme or the send lists encodes a line total, VMAX, Y_OUT_SIZE, EBD position or SLVS count. test1 therefore shows a window change is harmless, not that the sensor emitted more lines. ([E0700](../evidence/0700-a6400-open-gate-fe-input-cap-and-002-mmio-trace.md))
- **C46** `OFFLINE` No reglist column carries a ~4000-line readout. In the 13-column dump the largest Y_SIZE is 3396 (column 11); columns 9/10/11 differ from each other in exactly rows 10-13, so 708/2780/3396 are one knob. The five modes whose size_rows V is 4000 (drive keys 0x0B, 0x37, 0x68, 0x4E, 0x2F) select columns 0/1/2, which carry the untouched boot default 106/1132, identical to the staging initial bytes 0x645A1F24=0x04 and 0x645A1DAC=0x6C. The still class is a 53-register switch (0x0000 0x0C->0x04, 0x0001 0x41->0x04, the 0x002C-0x0033 and 0x0038-0x0043 groups, 0x006F, 0x08F1, 0x0924, 0x0ABA and others), so the still line count is sensor-internal and a row-10-13 patch cannot express it. The 65 unreferenced staging cells are mode-invariant and the 344-hit sweep of 0x6379B000-0x637A3000 finds only two readers of 0x63F109E1 and no VMAX/EBD/Y_OUT_SIZE/OP register. ([E0702](../evidence/0702-a6400-open-gate-r5-r6-and-still-vs-4k-diff.md))
- **C49** `OFFLINE` The IMX284 driver does make one height decision but never writes a sensor register from it. 0x6379F00C at 0x6379F034..0x6379F048 compares a caller-supplied u16 against h16(size_rows[idx]+0x3C) for drive keys {0x0B,0x37,0x68,0x4E,0x2F} and branches to 0x6379E3DC (request <= V_active) or 0x6379E43C (request > V_active); both only set [this+0x42C] to 2 or 1 and call 0x63CE80EC or 0x63CE80BC. Row 0's staging byte 0x6442F220 also aliases a u16 counter array at 0x6442F232..0x6442F23A, so row 0 is a bad patch target. ([E0702](../evidence/0702-a6400-open-gate-r5-r6-and-still-vs-4k-diff.md))
